# Graph path-template identifier normalization does not encode runtime path values

The extractor collects brace expressions and the generator snakeifies their names for Rust fields. Constructors take owned String values, and format_path interpolates those values directly into the request path. That name normalization does not percent-encode a runtime mail folder ID. Query selection uses a separate serializer, while URI parsing still unwraps. Keep this input boundary explicit; no invalid-ID, Graph server or network behavior was tested. Accepted endpoint-prefix support is a later phase, and generated formatting is not a manual style rule.

Scope: Graph extractor and generated request paths.
